request.description: Always returns 200. Copy the reset token logged by user-service (Password reset token issued... reset link) into the `resetToken` collection variable before running Reset Password.
Requires `resetToken` variable to be set from the Forgot Password response/log first.
First call auto-registers a User + SocialIdentity and returns a JWT. Calling again with the same providerUserId links back to the same account.
Resolves the profile whose email matches the authenticated JWT subject. Profiles are created automatically on registration.
